items.text: A Prophecy Against the King of Tyre
"Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Sovereign
I sit on the throne of a god
in the heart of the seas."
But you are a mere mortal and not a god,
though you think you are as wise as a god.
Is no secret hidden from you?
you have gained wealth for yourself
By your great skill in trading
I am going to bring foreigners against you,
they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom
They will bring you down to the pit,
and you will die a violent death
in the heart of the seas.
Will you then say, "I am a god,"
in the presence of those who kill you?
You will be but a mortal, not a god,
in the hands of those who slay you.
You will die the death of the uncircumcised
I have spoken, declares the Sovereign
"Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: 'This is what the Sovereign
full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
on the day you were created they were prepared.
You were anointed as a guardian cherub,
You were on the holy mount of God;
you walked among the fiery stones.
You were blameless in your ways
from the day you were created
till wickedness was found in you.
So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God,
and I expelled you, guardian cherub,
So I threw you to the earth;
I made a spectacle of you before kings.
By your many sins and dishonest trade
So I made a fire come out from you,
and I reduced you to ashes on the ground
in the sight of all who were watching.
All the nations who knew you
you have come to a horrible end
"Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her

and among you I will display my glory.

and within you am proved to be holy.
I will send a plague upon you
and make blood flow in your streets.
The slain will fall within you,
with the sword against you on every side.

" 'No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign

says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.
